source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Topic 5.3.3 (PDF 133, printed 130).

blocks.text: Data cleaning (safai) aur transformation (shakal badalna) data ko analysis ke liye tayyar karne ke aham steps hain. Raw (kachche, bilkul shuru wale) data mein aksar ghaltiyan, missing values ya ghalat format hota hai. Sahi results ke liye zaroori hai ke aage barhne se pehle yeh problems theek ki jayein.

blocks.prompt: Analysis se pehle data saaf karna kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Ghaltiyan, khali jagahein aur duplicate (do baar aane wale) records results ko misleading (ghalat raah dikhane wala) bana dete hain.

items: Raw data analysis se pehle saaf karein aur theek shakal (format) mein badlein.
